title: Aurora 600 Air Purifier
key_sentences: The Aurora 600 removes dust, pollen and smoke particles from rooms of up to 45 square metres.
Its three-stage filter captures 99.97% of particles larger than 0.3 microns.
A night mode lowers the fan to a whisper, so the unit can run while you sleep.
All prices include delivery within the United Kingdom.
Never wash the main filter, because water destroys the filter fibres.
Every Aurora purifier is covered by a three-year warranty from the date of purchase.
The warranty covers faults in materials and workmanship but not damage caused by misuse.
